Location: Macau, Macao

工作說明

主要職責:
負責為永利澳門有限公司編制和處理外部非財務 / 可持續發展報告

職位介紹:
• 根據香港交易所（HKEX）環境、社會及管治（ESG）報告指南、國際財務報告準則永續發展揭露標準、全球評等倡議（GRI）和聯合國永續發展目標（UNSDG）管理永續發展報告策略和措施的製定和實施。
• 與財務、法律和營運等跨職能團隊合作，整合 ESG 數據並將其轉化為永續發展報告的有意義的見解並實現永續發展目標。
• 設計和維護強大的ESG 資料收集和管理系統，透過資料品質控制來追蹤關鍵的永續發展指標和指標。
• 分析永續性數據以確定趨勢、風險和改善機會。
• 準備準確、全面的永續發展報告，確保遵守報告架構、標準和指南。
• 與內部和外部利害關係人（包括審計師）聯絡，以確保永續發展數據和報告的準確性和完整性。
• 與內部和外部合作夥伴合作創建永續發展報告的內容、佈局和翻譯。
• 作為國際財務報告準則會計和永續發展標準整合的主題專家，為高階管理層提供見解和建議。
• 監控產業趨勢和基準測試計劃，以確定永續發展報告中需要改進和創新的領域。
• 依照指示協助永續發展總監進行臨時專案和其他專案。

職位要求:
工作經驗：
• 至少5年財務分析、會計或審計經驗。有財務報告經驗者優先。
• 優秀的專案管理和解決問題的能力，能夠確定任務優先順序、按時完成任務並同時管理多個專案。
• 了解 ESG 報告準則，包括香港交易所 ESG 報告指南附錄 C2、IFRS 永續發展揭露準則、GRI、SASB 等，SDG 和相關資料收集能力者優先。
• 具備資料分析和報告的專業知識，能夠解釋複雜的資料集並以清晰簡潔的方式呈現研究結果。
• 強大的人際溝通和溝通能力，能夠與跨職能團隊和各級利害關係人有效協作。
• 能夠看到大局和細節，並致力於準確性和資料完整性。
• 高度自我激勵與指導。
• 熟悉持續發展軟體和資料管理工具將是有利的。
教育程度：會計或金融學士學位
語言能力：能操流利粵語、英語及普通話和良好的中英文書寫技巧

item.description:
Company: City of New York

Location: New York, New York, United States

Compensation: $58,851 - $84,257 per year

Workplace Type: Onsite

Requirements: Proficiency in economic, statistical, and econometric analysis; Bachelor's degree in relevant fields; 0-3 years of experience depending on the title.

Job Description:

TASK FORCE: Policy and Operations Research

UNIT:Social Services, Labor and Sustainability

JOB TITLE: One (1) Assistant Analyst/ Analyst / Senior Analyst

CONTROL CODE: POR-25-02


SUMMARY:

The Mayor’s Office of Management and Budget (OMB) is the City government's chief financial agency. OMB's staff of analysts and experts assembles and oversees the Mayor’s expense and capital budgets, which fund the services and activities of more than 90 City agencies and entities. In addition, the agency is charged with evaluating the efficiency and cost-effectiveness of City services, economic and revenue forecasting, and implementing the City’s capital financing program.

Within OMB, the Policy and Operations Research Task Force is primarily responsible for analyzing fiscal and economic implications of the City’s policy initiatives and evaluating City agencies’ operations and programs, as well as conducting ad-hoc quantitative analysis.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

The duties of this position include the following:

-Provide research and analytical support to other OMB task forces and to City Hall.

-Select and apply appropriate economic, econometric, and statistical techniques to develop, shape, and evaluate City policies.

-Work with large datasets and administrative data.

-Produce draft documents and presentations related to the Task Force’s projects.

-Manage projects from inception to final deliverables, with increasing autonomy according to placement title.

-Maintain excellent work relationships with other OMB task forces and City agencies.


QUALIFICATIONS:

-Proficiency in economic, statistical, and econometric analysis and program evaluation.

-Must possess knowledge of statistical software, (e.g., Stata, R, etc.) and strong computer technology skills and the ability to learn new technology quickly.

-Excellent quantitative, analytical, and communication skills.

-Ability to process, analyze, and present information clearly and effectively.

-Exceptional attention to detail, as well as organizational and research skills.

-Collaborative and team-oriented.

-Capable of working on a wide variety of policy topics, including but not limited to homelessness, public health, and workforce development.

-Ability to work calmly and proficiently under pressure and to adhere to strict deadlines.

-Must be able to work evenings and weekends as needed.


REQUIREMENTS:

Assistant Analyst ($60,764+): Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics or a subject related to Social Services with no or one year of full-time experience in budgetary planning/management, financial analysis, public policy analysis or a related field.

Analyst ($77,327+): Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Public Policy Analysis/Administration, or a subject related to the specific assignment and a minimum of two years responsible budgetary planning/management, financial analysis, public policy analysis/administration or a related field; or an awarded Master's degree in Financial Management, Business, Public Administration or a field related to the specific assignment.

Senior Analyst ($86,995): Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Public Policy Analysis/Administration, or a subject related to the specific assignment and a minimum of three years of full-time experience in budgetary planning/management, financial analysis, public policy analysis/administration, or a related field; or an awarded Master's degree in Business, Public Policy Administration, Finance, Economics, or related field, and one year of relevant experience

A cover letter is required to be considered for this position

item.title: Senior Sustainability Enforcement Attorney - City of New York
item.description:
Company: City of New York

Location: New York, New York, United States

Compensation: $92,525 - $106,404 per year

Workplace Type: Hybrid

Requirements: Admission to the New York State Bar and one year of satisfactory legal experience or six months as an Agency Attorney Intern.

Job Description:

Join the fight against climate change and take advantage of a unique opportunity on the cutting edge of climate policy at the New York City Department of Buildings. DOB has an essential role in implementing and enforcing New York City’s ground-breaking climate policies, including Local Law 97, which significantly reduces greenhouse gas emissions from the city’s largest buildings. In a city where buildings contribute nearly three-quarters of our greenhouse gas emissions, a focus on efficiency, building energy usage, and decarbonization is critical. DOB is committed to becoming the nation’s premier municipal building organization, enhancing the quality of life for all New Yorkers, and making our city a safer and healthier place to live. Become a member of DOB’s Bureau of Sustainability team and make a real difference.

Under supervision of the Deputy Director, Sustainability Enforcement, the Senior Sustainability Enforcement Attorney will supervise an enforcement team, and work on enforcement cases and projects with Sustainability Bureau staff, as well as other units in the agency.

Duties include but are not limited to:
-Working with Sustainability Bureau staff to promote effective enforcement and compliance, including reviewing procedures, developing enforcement policy, improving coordination and communication among the regulated community, and performing enforcement-related training.
-Performing all areas of case management, including initial and continuing research, designing an appropriate legal strategy, developing and overseeing a case tracking system, managing pre-trial settlement agreements, and preparing and prosecuting cases at the Office of Administrative Trials and Hearings (OATH).
-Supervising an enforcement team of attorneys and paralegals.
-Preparing reports and related analyses on cases and/or enforcement processes.
-Supporting collection of penalties and fines assessed.
-Proposing new ideas for overall enforcement initiatives and programs.
-Managing special projects and assignments.
-Any other duties as assigned.

REMOTE WORK
This position may be eligible for remote work up to 2 days per week, pursuant to the Remote Work Pilot Program.

To Apply:
Visit Jobs NYC (cityjobs.nyc.gov) to view and apply for available positions. Search by agency (Department of Buildings), keywords, or for the specific Job ID #.

NOTE: ONLY THOSE CANDIDATES UNDER CONSIDERATION WILL BE CONTACTED.

Qualifications:

1. Admission to the New York State Bar; and either "2" or "3" below.
2. One year of satisfactory United States legal experience subsequent to admission to any state bar; or
3. Six months of satisfactory service as an Agency Attorney Interne (30086).
Incumbents must remain Members of the New York State Bar in good standing for the duration of this employment.

To be assigned to Assignment Level (AL) II, candidates must have one year of experience at Assignment Level I or two years of comparable legal experience subsequent to admission to the bar, in the areas of law related to the assignment. item.description:
Company: City of New York

Location: Queens, NY, United States

Compensation: $35,110.4 - $35,110.4 per year

Workplace Type: Onsite

Requirements: Intern must be a college student or recent graduate with a focus on environmental studies or engineering, with a minimum GPA of 2.5.

Job Description:

The NYC Department of Environmental Protection (DEP) enriches the environment and protects public health for all New Yorkers by providing 1.1 billion gallons of high-quality drinking water, managing wastewater and storm water, and reducing air, noise, and hazardous materials pollution. DEP is the largest combined municipal water and wastewater utility in the country, with nearly 6,000 employees. DEP's water supply system is comprised of 19 reservoirs and 3 controlled lakes throughout the system’s 2,000 square mile watershed that extends 125 miles north and west of the City.

The Bureau of Engineering Design & Construction (BEDC) currently has a portfolio of capital projects valued at $23.8B, and another $10.5B projected over the next 10-year commitment plan. The projects BEDC implements allows DEP as a whole to continue to operate and maintain an exemplary water supply system.

BEDC seeks to hire a Sustainability Intern for the In-house Design (IHD) directorate located in Queens, NY. Under supervision, the selected candidate supports capital projects by assisting on the implementation of sustainability initiatives on capital projects; data compilation and analysis of existing programs, system management and outreach; support of individual project review and compliance task tracking; and conducting regulatory research. This project-specific work provides an intern experience that resembles an entry level sustainability job, preparing the candidate for graduation. In addition, each summer intern develops one special project in an area that is of personal interest and of a research need of the Bureau; these undergraduate projects are typically more technically focused. Past projects included the waste tracking database, stormwater design guidance, carbon accounting tools and material research.

item.title: Ingénieur Procédés confirmé F/H - Technip Energies
item.description:
Company: Technip Energies

Location: Vaulx-en-Velin, Rhône, France

Workplace Type: Onsite

Requirements: At least 5 years of experience in process design in petrochemicals and/or sustainable chemistry, with a degree in chemical engineering or equivalent.

A propos de Technip Energies :

Technip Energies est une entreprise d’ingénierie avec des technologies de premier plan au service de la transition énergétique, avec des positions de leader dans le Gaz Naturel Liquéfié (GNL), l'hydrogène et l'éthylène et avec une présence forte sur les marchés en croissance de l'hydrogène bleu et vert, la chimie durable, l’économie circulaire et la gestion du CO2. L’entreprise bénéficie de son solide modèle de livraison de projet, soutenu par une offre étendue de technologies, de produits et de services.  Avec une présence dans 34 pays, nos 15 000 collaborateurs sont pleinement engagés à donner vie aux projets innovants de nos clients, en repoussant les limites du possible pour accélérer la transition énergétique vers un avenir meilleur. 

Nous vous offrons non seulement une opportunité, mais aussi une expérience inspirante dans un environnement véritablement international où vous faites équipe pour repousser les frontières grâce à l'innovation, la créativité et l'esprit d'équipe exprimés par nos collaborateurs.

 

A propos de Technip Lyon :

Au sein de l’univers Technip Energies, le Centre Opérationnel de Lyon est référencé comme le centre d’expertise du groupe dans les domaines des Technologies Biosourcées, de la Chimie Durable et des Polymères. Notre centre accompagne le développement de technologies innovantes dans des domaines tels que l’économie circulaire, les biotechnologies et la chimie durable. Vous l’avez compris, ce centre de plus de 580 personnes, répond à une diversité de projets d’ingénierie de dimensions diverses (plus de 400 millions € pour certains projets) avec un positionnement sur des projets de conception très en amont et techniquement très riches pour nos ingénieurs.

 

A propos du poste :

Rattaché au Responsable de la Division  Procédés et Technologies du Centre Opérationnel de Lyon, vous intervenez dans les domaines de la chimie durable, des biocarburants, des polymères, de la pétrochimie, de l’économie circulaire et du chlore dans le cadre de projets d'envergure internationale.

Votre rôle est d’assurer et de coordonner toutes les activités de process design pour tout type de procédés dans le cadre de propositions, études de faisabilité, études de base, FEED, études de réalisation, dans le respect des règles et des procédures, du planning, du budget, avec un souci permanent de la qualité, de la sécurité, des objectifs, de la satisfaction du Client.

 

Vos missions principales sont :

  • Analyser les documents techniques contractuels pour les projets et les propositions,
  • Préparer les documents techniques pour les propositions,
  • Préparer les bases de design process pour un nouveau projet,
  • Prendre en charge les problèmes complexes de conception process,
  • Encadrer des jeunes ingénieurs et vérifier leurs documents,
  • Conduire une revue PID,
  • Apporter la connaissance process dans les revues HAZOP et revues SIL,
  • Apporter le support process aux autres disciplines à tous les stades d’un projet, de l’étude de base au démarrage, selon les besoins,
  • Assurer l’interface process avec les autres disciplines à l'intérieur d'un projet,
  • Analyser les offres des fournisseurs,
  • Faire des rapports sur l’avancement des projets,
  • Rédiger des notes de feedback à la fin d'un projet,
  • Participer à la rédaction des manuels opératoires, des procédures de commissioning et des tests de performance
  • Participer aux opérations de pre-commissioning, commissioning, démarrage.

 

A propos de vous :

Vous êtes diplômé(e) d'une école d’ingénieur en génie chimique (ou génie des procédés) ou équivalent, idéalement complété par un cursus post-ingénieur en procédés pour les projets de l’énergie.

Vous maitrisez plusieurs outils de simulation de procédés parmi Aspen Hysis, Aspen+, PRO II, HTRI, Pipenet, Flarenet.

Vous justifiez d’au moins 5 années d’expérience en process design dans le domaine de la pétrochimie et/ou chimie durable. Vous avez déjà dirigé des petites équipes d’ingénieurs.

Vous aimez travailler sur des projets variés, avec des équipes renouvelées et être impliqué dans les phases de conception et de réalisation d’unités bio-sourcées, pétrochimiques ou chimiques. 

Curieux et motivé pour être acteur de la transition énergétique, vous souhaitez découvrir de nouvelles technologies ou des procédés innovants ou approfondir vos connaissances sur certains types de procédés.

Autonome, dynamique et réactif(ve), vous avez de bonnes facultés de communication et évoluez avec aisance dans un environnement multiculturel.

Vous parlez couramment français et anglais et êtes motivé et disponible pour des déplacements en France et à l'étranger.

 

Votre avenir chez Technip Energies :

La diversité des secteurs d’activité et des procédés suivis par le Centre Opérationnel de Lyon alimentera votre curiosité et votre soif d’apprendre pendant de nombreuses années.

Très rapidement, vous allez être Leader Procédé sur projet avec la gestion d’une équipe d’ingénieurs procédés. Au départ, sur des projets de petite taille, puis sur des projets de plus en plus gros.

Vous pourrez également vous orienter vers le développement technologique pour tenir à terme un poste de Technology Manager ou de Licensing Manager au plus près de nos clients et de nos partenaires bailleurs de licence. Ces activités pourront être réalisées pour le Centre Opérationnel de Lyon mais également en collaboration avec nos autres centres technologiques comme Paris, Houston, Boston, Rome ou Zoetermeer.

Porte d’entrée du monde de l’ingénierie, l’expérience acquise au sein de la Division Procédés & Technologies vous permettra aussi d’évoluer comme ingénieur de projet, ingénieur estimation, ingénieur en sécurité industrielle ou de vous épanouir dans des fonctions comme le développement commercial ou la gestion des approvisionnements.

 

Processus de recrutement :

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

  • Suite à la réception de votre candidature, celle-ci sera examinée par un recruteur. Un retour vous sera fait sous quelques semaines. Pour avoir un aperçu du processus de recrutement, consultez notre page web dédiée ici
  • Nous vous invitons à en savoir plus sur notre entreprise en consultant www.ten.com  et suivez-nous sur LinkedIn , Instagram  pour toutes dernières informations

At Genesis, we are our clients’ trusted advisors on the journey to a sustainable future. For over 30 years, Genesis has developed an unrivalled track record and reputation for high-quality, high-impact solutions. We work in true partnership with our clients and are problem solvers who are at the forefront of innovation and technology; our world-class experience, individual expertise and collective wisdom are what differentiates us. In agreement with our clients, and to the benefit of the development or project, we can access the global expertise of Technip Energies, consisting of 15,000+ personnel across the globe. Abschlussarbeit (Bachelor- oder Masterarbeit) im Bereich Verfahrenstechnik –

CO₂-Abscheidung mit Zentrifugalreaktoren

 

Die Auswirkungen des Klimawandels sind unübersehbar, und eine der größten Herausforderungen unserer Zeit ist die Reduktion von Treibhausgasen, insbesondere CO₂, in der Atmosphäre. Eine vielversprechende Methode, um diese Herausforderung zu meistern, ist die CO₂-Abscheidung (Carbon Capture). Eine wichtige Technologie in diesem Bereich ist die chemische Absorption und Desorption mit Hilfe geeigneter Lösemittel.

Über uns:

Die ANDRITZ Separation GmbH ist ein führendes Maschinenbauunternehmen, das innovative Lösungen für die Industrie entwickelt. Unser Fokus liegt unter anderem auf der Entwicklung und Produktion von Zentrifugalreaktoren, die auch für die CO₂-Abscheidung eingesetzt werden können. Diese Technologie zeichnet sich durch eine hohe Effizienz aus, die durch die optimale Flüssigkeitsverteilung im Zentrifugalfeld des Reaktors erreicht wird.

 

Deine Aufgaben:

Im Rahmen deiner Abschlussarbeit wirst du die Möglichkeit haben, einen Versuchsstand für die CO₂-Abscheidung mit dem ANDRITZ Zentrifugalreaktor RPB zu entwickeln und spannende Experimente durchzuführen. Deine Aufgaben umfassen:

 

  • Einarbeitung in die Grundlagen der CO₂-Abscheidung mittels chemischer Absorption und Desorption durch umfangreiche Literaturrecherche.
  • Aufbau eines Versuchsstands im Labormaßstab, der den Absorptionsprozess von CO₂ mithilfe des Zentrifugalreaktors RPB abbildet.
  • Durchführung von Versuchen mit verschiedenen Lösemitteln und Prozessparametern zur Untersuchung der Effizienz der CO₂-Abscheidung.
  • Auswertung der Versuchsergebnisse und detaillierte Bewertung der unterschiedlichen Prozessparameter.
  • Dokumentation und Präsentation der Ergebnisse in einem abschließenden Bericht.

 

 

Was du mitbringen solltest:

  • Laufendes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium im Bereich Verfahrenstechnik, Chemieingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet.
  • Interesse an Umwelttechnik und nachhaltigen Technologien.
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Thermodynamik, Fluidmechanik und chemische Reaktionstechnik.
  • Eigenständige Arbeitsweise sowie analytisches Denkvermögen.
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- oder Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

 

Was wir dir bieten:

  • Ein innovatives und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld mit der Möglichkeit, an einem zukunftsweisenden Projekt im Bereich der CO₂-Abscheidung mitzuwirken.
  • Fachliche Betreuung durch erfahrene Ingenieure und Wissenschaftler.
  • Eine praxisorientierte Abschlussarbeit, die dich auf eine Karriere in der Industrie vorbereitet.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zur Integration der Arbeit in dein Studium.

item.description:
Company: Orbia

Location: Netherlands

Workplace Type: Onsite

Requirements: Seeking a Specialist Commercial with expertise in sustainable urban water management and climate adaptation, with at least 5 years of relevant experience.

   

Kom bij Wavin: Waar een doel tot leven komt. 

 

Jij bent gedreven door een doel. Gericht op groei. Klaar om je potentieel te vergroten. Welkom bij Wavin - een Orbia-bedrijf waar ons doel om het leven in de hele wereld te verbeteren ons volledige wereldwijde team motiveert. Elke dag denken we groot en werken we slim om enkele van de moeilijkste uitdagingen aan te pakken die onze wereld beïnvloeden. Of het nu gaat om het faciliteren van schoon drinkwater voor gemeenschappen, het creëren van klimaatbestendige steden of het ontwerpen van comfortabelere leefruimtes, we settelen nooit voor "goed genoeg" wanneer er een mogelijkheid is om het leven te verbeteren. 

Waar ons doel tot leven komt, veranderen levens. Hier leven we voor. En jij? 

 

Bij Wavin verbeteren we het leven in de wereld door gezonde, duurzame omgevingen te creëren. En waar is onze hulp het meest nodig? Precies daar waar we wonen: onze steden waar drinkwater weglekt, groen verdwijnt, straten overstromen na zware regenval en verouderde rioleringssystemen ons grondwater vervuilen. Het is tijd om krachten te bundelen, ons team te versterken en mee te helpen aan het bouwen van meer duurzame omgevingen! 

 

We willen een team opbouwen van mensen gedreven door verbetering en groei. Daarom zijn we momenteel op zoek naar een Specialist Commercial (infrastructure) om ons team te versterken bij Orbia B&I - Wavin Nederland. Als je het verschil wilt maken en samen met jouw collega’s kansen voor een betere waterhuishouding wilt realiseren, lees dan verder. 

 

Specialist Commercial (infrastructure)

Ben jij de specialist op het gebied van duurzaam stedelijk waterbeheer en klimaatadaptatie met commerciële ambitie en/of ervaring? Dan zoeken we jou! Als Specialist Commercial ben jij de spil in het realiseren van onze verkoopplannen op het gebied van infrastructuur en klimaatadaptatie. Je verstrekt technisch advies aan klanten en vergroot daarmee onze successen bij verkoopactiviteiten. Daarnaast speel je een sleutelrol in het promoten en creëren van productinnovaties; met focus op het managen van de hemelwater cyclus in combinatie met de vergroening van stedelijk gebied. 


Wat ga je doen? 

  • Je beheert en breidt ons netwerk uit, met een focus op  (landschaps)architecten, ingenieursbureaus, gemeenten en ontwikkelaars van grote projecten in de Randstad. 
  • Je vergroot onze slagingskans door strategisch advies en ondersteuning te bieden in verschillende fasen van een project: 
    • Advies over het vergroenen van steden en hemelwateroplossingen van Wavin 
    • Opstellen van technische ontwerpen en berekeningen 
    • Begeleiding van ontwerp en uitvoering van projecten 
  • Je creëert nieuwe kansen op de middellange termijn door actief betrokken te zijn bij de initiatie- en specificatiefase van complexe en grote projecten 
  • Je versterkt het kennisniveau bij klanten en collega’s door jouw trainingen en expertise.  
  • Je volgt de ontwikkelingen op het gebied van klimaatadaptatie op de voet en weet dit te vertalen naar commerciële of product ontwikkel mogelijkheden die jij samen met collega’s vorm geeft.  

 

Profiel 

  • Je hebt diepgaande kennis en expertise in klimaatadaptatie en hemelwaterbeheer. 
  • Je weet de verbinding te leggen tussen vergroening van steden, sportcomplexen en bouwlocaties en circulair waterbeheer.  
  • Je hebt commerciële ervaring of aantoonbaar affiniteit met klantcontact, netwerken en de wil om aan tafel te komen. 
  • Je bent gedreven om technische vraagstukken te signaleren en op te lossen op een pragmatische manier. 
  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in een technisch commerciële omgeving.
  • Je beschikt over een bachelorsdiploma of hebt een vergelijkbaar werk- en denkniveau. 
  • Je hebt kennis en ervaring met processen in de bouw en infrastructuur sector. 
  • Je hebt een netwerk met relevante contacten op het gebied van hemelwaterbeheer en klimaatadaptatie (is een pre). 

 

Wavin biedt
Wil je een verschil maken door te werken met een doel? Reken op een warm welkom bij Wavin! Bij Wavin moedigen we al onze medewerkers aan om hun talent te ontwikkelen en de beste versie van zichzelf te worden met geweldige innovatieve programma's. Hier nemen we verantwoordelijkheid voor elkaar en ons bedrijf. We blijven moedig in het nemen van berekende risico's die innovatie stimuleren. En we omarmen diversiteit in perspectieven, vaardigheden en talenten om te transformeren in de manier waarop we werken en de die we hebben op de wereld. Samen, als een sterk team, groeien we en komen we elke dag ons doel na. Wavin is de plek om te zijn als je echt een impact wilt maken. Naast het werken met een enthousiast, professioneel team in een internationale omgeving, bieden we een competitief salaris- en arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket. 

 

Organisatie
Wavin, onderdeel van Orbia's Bouw- en Infrastructuursector, is een innovatieve leverancier van oplossingen voor de wereldwijde bouw- en infrastructuurindustrie. Met meer dan 60 jaar ervaring in productontwikkeling verbetert Wavin het leven in de hele wereld door gezonde, duurzame omgevingen te creëren voor wereldburgers. Of het nu gaat om het verbeteren van de distributie van schoon drinkwater, het toegankelijk maken van sanitaire voorzieningen voor iedereen, het creëren van klimaatbestendige steden of het ontwerpen van comfortabele leefruimtes, Wavin werkt samen met gemeentelijke leiders, ingenieurs, aannemers en installateurs om gemeenschappen, gebouwen en huizen toekomstbestendig te maken. Wavin heeft meer dan 12.000 medewerkers op 65 productielocaties wereldwijd en bedient meer dan 80 landen via een wereldwijd verkoop- en distributienetwerk. 

 

Wavin is een onderdeel van Orbia. Een bedrijf dat wordt gedreven door een gezamenlijk doel: het verbeteren van het leven in de wereld. Orbia opereert in de sectoren Polymeeroplossingen (Vestolit en Alphagary), Bouw en Infrastructuur (Wavin), Precisielandbouw (Netafim), Connectiviteitsoplossingen (Dura-Line) en Fluorhoudende oplossingen (Koura). De vijf Orbia bedrijfsgroepen hebben gezamenlijk als focus het vergroten van de toegang tot gezondheid en welzijn, het heruitvinden van de toekomst van steden en woningen, het waarborgen van voedsel- en watervoorziening, het verbinden van gemeenschappen met informatie en het versnellen van een circulaire economie met basis- en geavanceerde materialen, gespecialiseerde producten en innovatieve oplossingen. Orbia heeft commerciële activiteiten in meer dan 110 landen en is actief in meer dan 50 landen, met wereldwijde hoofdkantoren in Boston, Mexico-Stad, Amsterdam en Tel Aviv. Het bedrijf genereerde $9,6 miljard aan omzet in 2022.

Als je vragen hebt of meer wilt weten over de positie, neem dan contact op met Remko van Luik via Remko.van.Luik@orbia.com.

Description

About Bizzell US: 

Bizzell US (Bizzell) is a HUBZone-certified, consulting, strategy, investment, and technology firm that designs innovative solutions to help build healthy, secure, connected and sustainable communities in our nation and around the world. Bizzell leverages the combined experience of our diverse subject matter experts to develop data-driven, research-informed answers to the world’s most complex challenges – ensuring our clients achieve their vision and goals through innovative solutions.

Bizzell's core values—Excellence, Integrity, Service, Innovation, Professional Development, People First, Diversity, and Collaboration—drive us to exceed expectations, providing a proactive, innovative approach to facilities maintenance.


Job Summary:

Bizzell US has an immediate need for an Energy Conservation Manager at NASA's AMES Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) in Mountainview, CA. The Energy Conservation Manager will spearhead efforts to enhance energy efficiency, reduce energy consumption, and promote sustainability across the JPL campus. The role requires extensive experience in energy management, project coordination, and collaboration with multidisciplinary teams. The manager will develop and implement energy conservation strategies, monitor energy usage, and ensure compliance with JPL's stringent standards and regulatory requirements.

Requirements

Responsibilities:

• Develop and implement energy conservation strategies and programs tailored to JPL's unique operational needs and goals.

• Monitor and analyze energy usage data specific to JPL’s facilities to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.

• Conduct detailed energy audits and assessments across various JPL buildings and infrastructure to identify energy-saving opportunities and recommend actionable solutions.

• Collaborate with JPL's engineering, facilities, and operations teams to implement energy-efficient technologies and practices.

• Prepare and present detailed reports on energy performance, savings, and project outcomes to JPL senior management and stakeholders.

• Ensure compliance with all relevant energy regulations, standards, and best practices applicable to JPL.

• Educate and train JPL staff on energy conservation practices and the importance of energy efficiency.

• Stay current with industry trends, technologies, and best practices in energy management and sustainability, with a focus on applications relevant to JPL.

• Regularly compile and submit monthly Natural Gas Consumption Reports for energy-intensive facilities at JPL, ensuring timely delivery by the 30th of each subsequent month.

• Track and report monthly natural gas consumption data for energy-intensive facilities, identifying areas for potential energy savings.


Key Qualifications:

• Strong knowledge of energy management principles, practices, and technologies, particularly in high-tech and research environments.

• Experience conducting energy audits, assessments, and performance evaluations in facilities similar to those at JPL.

• Proficiency in data analysis and energy monitoring tools specific to research and development facilities.

• Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting JPL's standards for scope, schedule, and budget.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders within a research and development setting.

• Knowledge of relevant energy regulations, standards, and best practices applicable to high-tech and research institutions.

• Experience with energy management software and systems used in research environments.


Education and Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in Energy Management, Engineering, Environmental Science, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.

• California Licensed Professional Engineer (Electrical PE).

• Certified Energy Manager (CEM) or similar certification is highly desirable.

• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.

• LEED Green Associate certification.

• CAL/OSHA Certificate (Construction Jobsite Safety and Health).

• Minimum of 10 years of experience in energy management, energy efficiency, or sustainability, with a proven track record of successful project delivery in complex and large-scale facilities.


Preferred:

• Experience working in a research or academic institution, particularly with NASA or similar organizations.

• Knowledge of sustainable building practices, renewable energy technologies, and smart building systems relevant to research and development facilities.

• LEED accreditation or experience with green building certifications.

item.title: Project Officer, Social Media (Volunteer) - SDSN Youth
item.description:
Company: SDSN Youth

Location: North America

Workplace Type: Remote

Requirements: Experience managing social media accounts, fluency with various platforms, strong communication skills, and a passion for youth engagement and sustainable development.

DEADLINE: June 15, 2025

This role is ideal for someone passionate about world history, sustainability, education, youth engagement, and digital storytelling. You will be responsible for managing and expanding Ages of Globalization’s presence on social media, including youth takeovers. You’ll work directly with the AoG education team and gain hands-on experience in global educational communications and shape and grow a purpose-driven digital identity from the ground up. This is a volunteer position requiring an average of 10 hours per week (flexible and remote).

Ages of Globalization is a free, multidisciplinary online course designed to empower a global community of learners — students ages 14+, educators, and lifelong learners alike — to address today’s sustainable development challenges. This course takes participants on an immersive journey through seven
transformative ages of human history, examining how geography, technology, and institutions have shaped our interconnected world. Based on Professor Jeffrey D. Sachs' influential book, the course deepens learners’ understanding of global history, the forces driving large-scale change, and innovative
solutions for a sustainable future. Through dynamic video lectures, virtual visits to UNESCO World Heritage Sites, expert interviews, cutting-edge ESD lesson plans, and engaging activities, learners are equipped with the knowledge, skills, attitudes and values to tackle complex global issues

Global Schools is an initiative led by the UN Sustainable Development Solutions Network in support of UNESCO’s ESD for 2030 Roadmap. Its mission is to empower schools and teachers globally to educate students on sustainable development, global citizenship, and 21st century skills. The vision of the
program is with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and to encourage them to prioritize the goals in their lifestyles, behaviors, education, and professional careers. The program aims to do this by transforming learning environments globally and making schools hubs of Education for Sustainable
Development (ESD), ultimately becoming vehicles for mobilizing students to take local leadership for the SDGs in their communities.

Organized by Global Schools, UN at Your Doorstep is the live component of “Ages of Globalization,” for high-school assemblies, extra-curricular activities, Model UN clubs, community NGOs, or the traditional classroom. These online dialogues offer an unprecedented opportunity for high-schoolers to directly
engage with world leaders and UN officials to discuss how to solve the biggest challenges of our time, such as climate change, poverty and inequalities. UN at Your Doorstep live dialogues are vibrant forums for engagement and inspiration, where students can ask questions, seek advice, and gain insights on how
to take action for a more just, peaceful and sustainable world. Students are at the forefront of global discussions, adding an enriching co-curricular element to their educational journeys.

To elevate our reach and deepen engagement across our global community, we are seeking a Project Officer to lead the implementation and growth of AoG’s social media presence across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, BlueSky and YouTube. The Project Officer will play a key role in executing the AoG digital communications strategy, coordinating and creating content, and supporting monthly UN at Your Doorstep youth-led takeovers.

RESPONSIBILITIES
The primary responsibilities of the Project Officer include but are not limited to:

Social Media Strategy & Content Management

● Implement AoG’s 2025 social media strategy across all platforms.
● Maintain a content calendar and coordinate 2–3 posts per week across platforms.
● Develop and schedule engaging content (visuals, videos, text) using Canva and building on the AoG Brand Guide.
● Ensure brand consistency across platforms in tone, visuals, and messaging.

Youth Takeovers & UN at Your Doorstep
● Coordinate youth-led social media takeovers linked to UN at Your Doorstep events (approx. on a monthly basis).
● Support young moderators and contributors with onboarding, content prep, and takeover guidance.

Community Engagement & Growth
● Increase followers and engagement through campaigns, interactive content, cross-posting with partners, and occasional paid boosts (if available).
● Monitor analytics, log data in the AoG engagement tracker and prepare brief monthly performance reports (orally or in writing) with learnings and content suggestions.
● Support in the scoping of partnerships to help build a list of target audiences, such as education influencers, and prepare communications materials for outreach.

BENEFITS

● Be at the forefront of efforts taken by the United Nations, governmental and civil society in developing and leading a global movement for sustainable development;
● Have the opportunity to attend high-level domestic and international virtual meetings and conferences and network with some of the most prominent figures in this space;
● Supported by our global team of experts across a range of areas, progress rapidly in a
challenging but flexible and fulfilling environment.
● Gain exposure and experience relevant to building a career in international development

QUALIFICATIONS
● Experience managing organizational or campaign-focused social media accounts
● Fluency with Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, and emerging platforms (BlueSky)
● Familiarity with Canva and Publer (or other scheduling tools)
● Basic video editing skills and visual storytelling capability
● Strong written communication and content creation skills
● A passion for youth engagement, education, and sustainable development
● Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and collaborate remotely with a global team.

CONDITIONS
● Time Commitment: 10 hours/week, with room for flexibility
● Location: Remote and flexible (with one weekly coordination meeting and occasional UN at Your Doorstep live events and related youth social media takeover preparatory meeting)
● Training: The candidate is required to complete the Global Schools Program onboarding course, which is expected to take approximately 2-3 hours to complete.
● Start Date: June 2025 or as soon as possible
● Duration: Minimum 6 months commitment preferred, ideally 12 months.
● Compensation: This position is voluntary (unpaid).
● Reporting to: This position is supervised by Katja Anger-Delimi, Education Consultant, Ages of Globalization and UN at Your Doorstep Programs, working remotely from Portland Oregon USA & Amanda Abrom, Director of Global Schools.

In addition, the Corporate Social Responsibility & Belonging teams support the company’s environmental and social commitments with a strong focus on pets, people and the planet.  The collective team supports the overall success and positive reputation of the company.  

About the Location:

Collaborative & Flexible Work Environment: We believe in fostering growth, teamwork and creativity in a dynamic workplace. This role is based at PetSmart’s Phoenix Home Office, where associates currently enjoy the benefits of in-person collaboration while having the flexibility to work remotely one day per week (a “flex workday” with leader approval), and an expected four days in the office. At PetSmart, you’ll be part of an engaging and supportive environment designed to help you and our teams thrive.

About the Job:

Job Summary:

The Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Strategy & Reporting Manager is responsible for helping to advance PetSmart’s overall CSR, sustainability and social impact priorities and reporting. This person is responsible for the collection, analysis, and management of environmental and social performance data, and supports the development of our annual Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) report.as well as regulatory compliance reporting in partnership across teams. Beyond reporting, this person is responsible for forward-looking,  data-driven improvement opportunities and working cross-functionally to support business partners in creating increased efficiency and opportunity across our enterprise.

 

Why You’ll Love This Role:

You’ll be the pulse-check of our progress and the catalyst for smarter, more sustainable decisions. This is a high-visibility, high-impact opportunity to use CSR data as a lever to reduce environmental impact, improve associate outcomes, and elevate the PetSmart brand for years to come.

 

Key Responsibilities:

CSR Data Strategy & Analysis (40%)

  • Design and maintain CSR data architecture, ensuring quality, transparency, and alignment with reporting frameworks (e.g., GRI, SASB, TCFD)
  • Collect, validate, and analyze environmental and social performance data across business units
  • Develop dashboards and executive-ready insights to track progress and financial impacts, inform decisions, and guide priority-setting

CSR Report Development & Regulatory Disclosure (30%)

  • Support the development of the annual CSR report and regulatory reporting including climate risk & extended producer responsibility (EPR), and stakeholder survey response process—timeline, stakeholder input, drafting, and approvals
  • Coordinate across Legal, Communications, Human Resources, Facilities, and other teams to build a cohesive, credible narrative
  • Stay ahead of evolving environmental and social disclosure expectations and trends to maintain PetSmart’s leadership position

Cross-Functional CSR Change Leadership (30%)

  • Translate insights into business-driving initiates through partnership with internal teams (e.g., Facilities, Procurement, Merchandising, Human Resources, Learning & Development)
  • Drive collaborative solutions that reduce environmental impact, enhance associate experience and engagement, and improve efficiency
  • Support PetSmart’s regulatory compliance and brand commitments by embedding CSR priorities across teams

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree from four-year college/university in a relevant field preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in sustainability strategy, CSR reporting, or data analytics in a corporate setting. GRI-certified (preferred)
  • Proven knowledge of sustainability reporting standards (GRI, CDP, TCFD, SASB, etc.) and materiality assessment
  • Excellent project management and stakeholder engagement skills across technical and non-technical teams
  • Experience developing data systems and translating insights into cross-functional action
  • Passion for environmental and social impact, and belief in business as a force for good

 

About the Culture:

At PetSmart, we work hard to create a culture where every associate feels like they truly belong and we celebrate the unique stories, backgrounds, and experiences our associates share.  These experiences not only bring new perspectives in shaping our Belonging culture but they’re core to PetSmart’s success.

item.description:
Company: Rise Baking Company

Location: Kent, Washington, United States

Compensation: $103,000 - $110,000 per year

Workplace Type: Onsite

Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Safety Management or equivalent work experience, OSHA certification preferred, minimum 3 years of experience in implementing and sustaining safety programs.

Job Purpose

Partner with plant management to ensure compliance with safety and environmental procedures. Provide safety and environmental leadership by ensuring plant systems are implemented, communicated, and sustained. Verify effectiveness of these programs by performing regular audits and communicating results to plant leadership teams. 

Essential Functions 

• Develop, implement, and continuously improve safety and environmental programs, policies, and procedures to ensure effectiveness and compliance with local, state, and federal rules and regulations 

• Provide direction, training, education, and technical support to ensure effective deployment of safety and environmental policies and procedures 

• Partner with plant management for successful completion of regulatory audits 

• Ensure the design, development, and implementation of hazardous waste management plans at the facility 

• Measure and monitor the overall safety and environmental performance of the facility and identify opportunities for improvement including tools, training, and processes 

• Understand federal and state occupational safety and health regulations and monitor for regulatory changes 

• Provide safety technical support and information to all departments to eliminate potential injury or exposure 

• Partner with facility to develop an emergency response team and ensure appropriate training in emergency response, spill response, disaster preparedness, and crisis management; ensure drills and equipment are in a ready state 

• Work with plant leadership teams to develop plant safety goals; create and implement plans to achieve goals and KPIs 

• Drive and promote zero incident culture and employee engagement throughout the facility 

• Direct accident investigation programs, identify accident trends, and develop programs for improving performance; partner with plant leadership teams to conduct incident investigations, complete necessary reports, make recommendations, and follow through with corrective actions to mitigate further risk 

• Ensure complete and effective incident, near miss, and first aid reporting; ensure root cause analysis of incidents and injuries; determine specific actions needed to prevent recurrence 

• Develop and maintain safety and environmental data processes to manage and report data such as injuries and illnesses, environmental metrics, risk assessments, action items, and other pertinent information; analyze safety data to lead and coordinate the safety effort for continual improvement 

• Ensure internal facility safety audits are completed regularly to detect existing or potential risks and hazards; work with facility management to ensure recommended corrective actions are completed in a timely manner 

• Complete risk assessment and recommend control measures for all potential areas of concern; evaluate nonstandard tasks to uncover risks and identify corrective actions 

• Ensure contractors have effective safety processes in place by implementing contractor pre-qualifications and monitoring/auditing work in progress 

• Partner with HR on workers’ compensation programs including managing and supporting transitional duty and return to work programs, staff training, and development  

• Foster a sense of team responsibility for achieving goals • Support food safety program, quality standards, and legality of manufactured products through adherence to plant GMPs  

• Perform other job-related duties as assigned 

Qualifications (Education, Experience, Competencies) 

• Bachelor’s degree in Safety Management or equivalent work experience 

• OSHA certification preferred • Familiarity with state environmental regulations preferred 

• Minimum 3 years of experience in implementing and sustaining safety programs 

• Knowledge of food manufacturing facilities 

• Extensive working knowledge of regulatory requirements for federal and state programs, processes, and program implementation strategies 

• Proficient in Microsoft Office and computer-based applications 

• Ability to develop, conduct, and maintain training programs using lecture, PowerPoint, or practical methods  

• Strong leadership, team-building, and coaching skills with an intense desire to drive positive change, develop interdepartmental relationships, and deliver results  

• Strong verbal and written communication skills 

• Strong decision-making skills with the ability to think critically and solve complex problems  

• Ability to organize, manage multiple priorities, and maintain high attention to detail in a fast-paced environment

In addition to your annual salary, Rise Baking Company offers benefits such as a comprehensive benefits package, annual bonus eligibility, incentive and recognition programs and 401k contributions (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements).
